headline: Clearer labels, smoother split view
summary: Manage labels with clearer controls, move between split boards smoothly, and save without leftover backup files.

improved.title: Clearer label controls
improved.description: Add labels explicitly, see which labels are shared by your selection, and apply or remove them with clear actions and Undo support.

improved.title: Smoother split view
improved.description: Opening and closing split view keeps images at their original size, with one continuous movement as the top bar appears.

improved.title: Updated app runtime
improved.description: RefBoard and its installer use an updated Electron runtime.

fixed.title: No leftover backups after successful saves
fixed.description: Successful saves no longer leave .bak files beside your boards. Recovery safeguards remain in place if a save is interrupted.

fixed.title: Label colors stay with the board
fixed.description: Label colors return when you reopen a board or restore a session, without carrying colors over from another board.

fixed.title: Safer interrupted saves
fixed.description: File handles are released after failed saves, and overlapping save and close requests preserve the correct board data.

fixed.title: Installer launch retries
fixed.description: If RefBoard cannot launch after installation, the installer stays open and offers a retry.
